enforced_by: the video teardown's doctrine read and the AI brief's frames; recorded as unknown, never refused
note: One list per visual dimension — shot, angle, camera, composition, light, colour, capture (the owner, 2026-10-13); the asset is the dimension.

rows.name: extreme-close
rows.what: One detail fills the frame — an eye, a texture, a drop.

extra.real: Phone macro: slight focus hunting, the texture itself sharp.

rows.name: close
rows.what: The face, or the hands and the product, fill the frame.

extra.real: Selfie distance: arm's length, slight wide-lens stretch near the edges.

rows.name: medium
rows.what: Waist up — a person and what they are doing.

extra.real: A propped phone on a counter or shelf, framed a little loose.

rows.name: wide
rows.what: The whole person in their place.

extra.real: Phone propped across the room; the place's clutter in frame.

rows.name: insert
rows.what: A cutaway to an object or an action — the product, the hands, the screen.

extra.real: Rear camera held over the action, shadow of the hand sometimes in frame.
